== Exact published English Set 11 text ==
The remaster replaces the alien forfeit reduction with battleground status for your docking bays controlled by the opponent and drops Nal Hutta from the download list. The generation bonus and Mobilization Points condition remain. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 20].
